job.value: Start browsing or searching for something to buy

arrivedFrom.value: Typing carousell.sg or clicking the logo

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Search sits at the top, but most of the first screen goes to two unrelated promos (TCG 'live speed auction' event and luxury watches) and 'Graded card auctions', so the page reads as a set of promos rather than a starting point.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The search bar competes with two large banners and the bright purple 'Graded card auctions' row for attention.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Search', 'View collection now' and 'See all' each say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'PSA 10', 'TCG' and 'Graded card auctions' are collector terms shown to every visitor on the homepage.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decisions are asked beyond what to search or tap.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Rows show a price and title per card, with more behind 'See all'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A concert-ticket scam warning ('Stay safe from ticket scams') and a niche graded-card row take the top of a general homepage.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Images and prices carry the screen; the banner copy is display text, not reading.
